tests.name: colcon test: no pose gives zero Twist; pose enables fixed command
real ROS graph: wrong topic has no subscribers and pose remains unchanged
real ROS graph: remap connects turtlesim, commands measured for 10 seconds, pose changes

defect.reproducer: ros2 run patrol patrol: /cmd_vel has 1 publisher and 0 subscribers, /turtle1/cmd_vel has 0 publishers and 1 subscriber; 100 commands in 10.001 s but pose remains (5.544445, 5.544445, 0).
defect.root_cause: The relative cmd_vel resolves to /cmd_vel, while turtlesim subscribes to /turtle1/cmd_vel. Matching Twist types do not connect differently named topics.
defect.proof_after: ros2 run patrol patrol --ros-args -r cmd_vel:=/turtle1/cmd_vel: 1 publisher and 1 subscriber; 100 commands in 10.001 s; pose moves from (6.256371, 5.706039) to (4.938362, 8.765225).
